The *Hetusampayuttaduka* (Patthana 14.3) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh book of the Pali canonical Abhidhamma Piṭaka. It systematically examines conditional relations based on the dyad (*duka*) of states associated with root causes (*hetusampayutta*) and those unassociated with root causes (*hetuvippayutta*), applying the conditional methods characteristic of the *Paṭṭhāna*.
